$comment: Golden cases for what acted, in words (SPEC §17, ADR 0023). functions/test/provenance.test.js asserts actedThrough gives `via` for each actor, and app/src/activity.test.ts asserts the app's viaOf gives the same for what it reads from Firestore itself, so the server and the browser cannot come to name an older record differently. `via` null means a person in the browser, who needs no words.

cases.name: the words stored when it acted
an older /mcp record, which may be the CLI or an app
a channel neither side knows names itself
